label: Whatever causes the being of everything else enters into the composition of nothing
paraphrase: Open bridge, analyst formulation, unattributed: whatever causes the being of everything else that is in act as to being is a component of nothing (RemoteFromAll). After ST I q.3 a.8's first reason: the first efficient cause is not numerically one with the form or matter of what it makes. Q.3 a.8 itself reports three contrary positions (God as world-soul, via Augustine; God as the formal principle of all things, the Amalricians; God as prime matter, David of Dinant) and, in obj. 1, Dionysius' 'the being of all is the deity'. RemoteFromAll is a different reading of Dei Filius's 'really and essentially distinct from the world', not that attribute: the anti-pantheist content is untyped.
